tldr: Pluto through the 4th house intensifies home, family, privacy, and emotional foundations.
body:
When Pluto moves through your 4th house, it brings pressure to home, family, privacy, memory, living space, roots, and what is happening behind closed doors. You may notice what is happening privately, what your home needs, or what old family and memory patterns are bringing into the present.

Something may no longer stay buried, controlled, avoided, or handled only on the surface. It can help you face the deeper truth and stop spending energy protecting a false version of peace.

The useful side is that this timing can make the next honest move easier to see. This is useful for tending to the base of your life instead of only managing what other people can see.

The caution: Watch for trying to control the outcome so tightly that you cannot tell what is changing naturally. The risk is retreating so far inward that nothing gets named or handled.

Pluto moves through this house for a long chapter. Work with the deeper truth instead of forcing everything back into the old shape.
